verified: CVE2 RV32E=1 uses the same full-top OBI ports and generated OBI CPU template; real execution and replay are checked by tests/local_harness/test_cve2_rv32e_profile_reuse.py.
unknown: This is a parameter variant of CVE2, not a new CPU model; it cannot alone satisfy the final Stage D requirement for an unintegrated CPU implementation.
